A '''blood pressure gauge''' was a medical [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. [[MD-0 medical droid]]s were fitted with blood pressure gauges as standard, using them to assist in diagnosing [[Disease/Legends|diseases]] and ailments.<ref name="SWS" />
